title: Rewrite login_screen.dart using design system
description: Rewrite login_screen.dart using the new design system primitives. Replace raw Material widgets with AppTextField, AppButton, AppCard, AppSnackbar. Use design tokens for all spacing/colors/typography. Preserve all behavior including BlocListener state handling, form validation, password visibility toggle, forgot password dialog, and navigation.
acceptance_criteria: flutter analyze passes with 0 errors on the file
Uses AppTextField for email and password fields
Uses AppButton for the login button
Uses AppCard for the form container
Uses AppSnackbar.error() and AppSnackbar.success() for feedback
Uses design tokens (AppColors, AppSpacing, AppTypography) for all styling
BlocListener behavior identical (AuthFailure, AuthAuthenticated, AuthSuccess states handled)
Form validation logic preserved (email and password validators)
Navigation preserved (login to home on success, login to register via link)
Forgot password dialog preserved with email input and validation
Double quotes used throughout, no emojis
completion_summary: Rewrote login_screen.dart using design system primitives (AppTextField, AppButton, AppCard, AppSnackbar) with full behavior preservation.
